description: Conformance vectors for H6022 over ble. Every SDK — the Rust core, its bindings and any hand-written port — must produce exactly these bytes for these arguments. The wire carries no envelope here, so a vector states `frames_hex` and no `message`. These are the plaintext frames the codec builds; on this unit the transport encodes them under the session seed of docs/protocol/ble.md 9 before they reach the air, which is a transport step and not part of the bytes below. The `33 05 0D` frames are sub-mode 13, colour and white in one layout; the `33 05 15` frames are sub-mode 21, which paints and dims by a mask 15 bits wide. See ../README.md.
